name: lem-hcb3-diagonal-unit
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb3-diagonal-unit — Uniform diagonal Ha unit estimate: there are universal C_unit < infinity and e_unit > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_unit and every n >= 1 satisfy ||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(I_n tensor u_P)-I|| <= C_unit*e.
